what: training hyperparameters of the Python-4 study's Gemma-4 12B, Gemma-4 31B and GLM-4.5-Air 110B runs: midtraining, Dolci SFT and the chat-vector graft (models); EFT, the clean 0/256/1,024-row dose (eft); GRPO on the 31B graft with its EFT-512 warm start, Run B-v2 (grpo)
source: assembled 2026-09-15 from the as-run configs, run manifests, trainer constants and specs on jb/python4-campaign @ ae468044 (experiments/python4/*, src/scimt/train/*); each row's files below; ledgers experiments/python4/CAMPAIGN_STATUS.md and WEIGHTS_INDEX.md name the canonical runs

notes.text: Arms: control = Dolmino only, token-matched to the iso-token arm; iso-token = the same 10.0M-token Python-4 corpus (four copies) at every scale; prop-token = a Python-4 dose proportional to parameter count, anchored at the whole 49.5M-token corpus for the 110B model (GLM run names: experimental = iso-token, experimental_50m = prop-token). Token counts are Gemma-3-tokenizer counts, the campaign's counting basis; the GLM step counts divide its own tokenizer's count of the same mixes (77.1M / 373.7M / 74.0M tokens) by 262,144. The four Python-4 copies are shuffled into an equal-token stream of Dolmino.

Base models are the pretrained (non-instruct) checkpoints; GLM-4.5-Air-Base is a mixture-of-experts model with 12B active parameters. All runs used H200 GPUs: 4 for Gemma-4 12B, 8 for Gemma-4 31B and for GLM-4.5-Air. Midtraining supervises every token (completion format). The Dolci SFT uses the train split of allenai/Dolci-Instruct-SFT after a strict user/assistant alternation filter (1,923,659 of 2,152,112 rows), packed to 8,192 tokens; 48 steps x 2,097,152 tokens = 100.7M tokens, the step cap binding inside one nominal epoch.
Chat-vector grafts exist for all three scales; RL was run only on the Gemma-4 31B prop-token graft. The graft takes tokenizer, config and chat template from the -it model.
Elicitation fine-tuning (EFT): one LoRA on each chat parent, the clean 0 / 256 / 1,024-row dose behind the main figure (0 = no EFT).

Gold rows are Boa-certified Python-4 solutions to held-in-rule problems; replay rows are Dolci prompts answered on-policy by the parent being tuned (T = 0.7); no held-out rule appears in any target. The 256-row dose is drawn from the 1,024 rows.

The campaign's matrix cells marked +EFT used a different, larger dose not shown in the paper's figures: 2,048 rows (1,843 Python-4 gold incl. held-out-rule problems + 205 canonical Dolci rows), 4 epochs = 256 steps, same LoRA recipe.

GLM's LoRA is attention-only because PEFT >= 0.19 remaps the MLP targets of its packed experts into target_parameters that vLLM cannot serve. The Gemma runs use HF Trainer + PEFT on one H200 per arm; the GLM run uses axolotl + FSDP2 on four H200s.

The Run B-v2 step-0 EFT adapter was lost with its pod; the committed replicate (510 rows, 30 steps, fresh replay) is the step-0 model of the ladder figure. An earlier cold run on the same graft (run-4) differed in: no warm start, verbatim Boa diagnostics, a shaped reward, truncated completions masked out of the loss, 1,024 training problems, stopped at step 32.
Unset GRPO fields are TRL 1.9.2 defaults; Adam betas and epsilon are framework defaults throughout and are not quoted.
